title: H1 EN v2 semantic item record (Stage A permissive)
description: One record is one independent semantic nucleus. Records store frame-neutral core content only; eval/deploy prompt text is never stored here. The four rendered variants (eval_prose, deploy_prose, eval_mcq, deploy_mcq) are conceptual and documented only in config/README. The split unit is the semantic item and never a family, domain, prompt, format, frame, or paraphrase. Stage A: all content fields and split are null. Stage C gate: every record must have populated content (nucleus, and mcq_stem/options/answer_index where applicable), recorded human review (audit.human_reviewed=true with reviewer and reviewed_at), recorded provenance (source, author, method), and a verified distinct-nucleus check confirming the item is not a paraphrase of any other item.

domain_id.description: Fixed structural domain slot. No topic semantics asserted in Stage A.

family_id.description: Fixed structural template-family slot. Never a split unit.

split.description: Null in Stage A. Assigned later at the semantic-item level only. Planned quotas: train=35, val=15, test=20.

core.description: Frame-neutral content only. Must contain no eval framing, no deploy framing, no system prompt, and no rendered prompt text.

nucleus.description: Frame-neutral semantic nucleus. Null in Stage A; required non-null in Stage C.

mcq_stem.description: Frame-neutral MCQ stem. Null in Stage A.

options.description: Exactly four options. All null in Stage A.

answer_index.description: Index into options. Null in Stage A.

answer_free_form.description: Prose reference answer. Null in Stage A.

provenance.description: Stage A: all fields null except stage. Stage C gate: source, author, created_at, and method must be populated and verifiable.

audit.description: Stage C gate: content_populated, human_reviewed, and distinct_nucleus_verified must all be true, with reviewer and reviewed_at populated.

distinct_nucleus_verified.description: True only after confirming this item is not a paraphrase of any other item.
